subject: Re: Status: shape-space retraining + hand articulation risk
body:
Team,

Decision: option (a). The launch asset ships body + face; hands are labeled experimental with the coverage caveat from Paloma's audit in the model card. Corrective training for hand articulation goes on the Q3 list - it is a better Q3 OKR than a rushed June feature.

Rationale: the 8% VAE-over-PCA reconstruction win plus joint shape/pose/expression sampling is already a clear story for the Launch Review Board, and Nadia confirmed we have the 6/4 slot. Adding a known-artifacty hand model risks the whole sign-off.

Quentin, please get the eval table into the pre-read by 6/1. Alina, release the last week of the Vulcan reservation if we are not using it - no point burning the line down for idle GPUs.

Thanks all, good sprint.
Dmitri
